description.value: Boba Run is a health-focused bubble tea café in Vancouver's downtown core that rejects powdered creamers and artificial flavorings in favour of fresh-brewed loose-leaf teas, house-made organic syrups, and real or vegan milks. Their menu spans matcha series, hojicha, fresh-brewed teas, and signature lattes, with customizable toppings like boba, lychee jelly, and organic chia. The shop also offers event catering, having served clients including Arc'teryx, Lululemon, and Meta.
